notes: The page prints only one requirements list, headed 'Requirements for the Certificate of Achievement' (Total Units 47), followed by 'General Education Requirements for the Associate in Science Degree'. I read the A.S. major as this same list plus general education. A reviewer should confirm this; the page prints no separate A.S. major list.
No degree total and no GE unit figure is printed. The GE section names PCC Local Gen Ed and Cal-GETC, with IGETC or CSU GE allowed for students with catalog rights to the former patterns.
Catalog codes carry leading zeros (CHDV 010, PSYC 021, etc.). I matched them to closed-list codes without zeros (CHDV 10, PSYC 21), so they are not marked as catalog additions.
CHDV 122 (Practicum in Early Intervention/Special Education, 2 units) and ESL 005 are not in the closed list; both are marked as catalog additions.
The Program Outcomes appear as a single list for the program page, which covers both the certificate and the A.S.; I recorded them for this award.
The careers come from the Child Development discipline introduction, which is shared across CHDV awards.
The catalog text begins mid-sentence, so part of the program description may be cut off.
The units for the alternatives (ENGL C1000, ENGL C1000H, ESL 005, PSYC 021H) are not printed and are left null.

Permit requirements (Associate Teacher, Teacher, Master Teacher, Site Supervisor) mention CHDV 012A, CHDV 012B and CHDV 119. These are permit requirements, not award requirements, and were not placed.
